definition: PauseAI is a global political movement founded in the Netherlands with the stated aim of achieving global coordination to stop the development of more powerful general artificial intelligence systems, at least until it is known how to build them safely, and keep them under democratic control.
details: The movement was established in Utrecht in May 2023 by software entrepreneur Joep Meindertsma.

explainer.lead: A global political movement founded in the Netherlands that seeks global coordination to stop development of more powerful general AI systems until they are known to be safe and under democratic control.

tiers.eli5: It is a campaign asking countries to agree to put the brakes on building stronger AI until people know how to do it safely.
tiers.practitioner: The movement operates as political advocacy rather than a technical toolset, aiming to pressure governments toward coordinated pauses. Its stated aim rests on the premise that safe construction of such systems is not yet known.
tiers.paperLevel: PauseAI is a movement, not a formal method: it calls for global coordination to halt development of more powerful general AI systems until they can be built safely and kept under democratic control.

explainer.example: A supporter joins a PauseAI demonstration outside a government building to press officials for an international agreement pausing frontier general AI development.
